children: Profrac Gdm, Llc, a 10% owner, reported a direct sale of common stock on September 11, 2026. The shares were sold at $26.01 per share as determined by the five-day volume-weighted average price ending September 10, 2026. The total sale amount was $60,000,024. Following the transaction, ProFrac GDM, LLC directly owned 3,693,194 shares of common stock. The sale consisted of 1,319,493 shares sold to THRC Holdings, LP and 987,313 shares sold to Farris Wilks in exchange for cancellation of Alpine Holding II, LLC term loans.
